description: This file defines the class AOP_Case_Updates, which manages case update records in SuiteCRM, including saving updates, parsing descriptions, retrieving related entities, and sending email notifications.

classes.name: AOP_Case_Updates
classes.description: A class extending Basic, representing case update records with methods for saving, parsing descriptions, retrieving related entities, and sending emails.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Cleans the name, parses the description, saves the record, and triggers email notification via hook.

methods.name: parseDescription
methods.description: Fixes unclosed HTML tags in the description field.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves linked contact beans for the case.

methods.name: getUpdateContact
methods.description: Retrieves the contact bean associated with this update.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user assigned to the case.

methods.name: getUpdateUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with this update.

methods.name: getEmailForUser
methods.description: Gets the primary email address of the user.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Prepares email subject and body by parsing templates with relevant data.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email using the provided template, signatures, and recipient addresses, and logs the email record.
